title: Step Backwards and Step Forwards only makes characters move in a straight line continuously?

posts.author: DeterminedKid1000
posts.body:
I'm not sure how to explain this, but character's don't take a step backwards or forwards when I try to set that in their movements? Instead they just keep walking? What do I do???
